name: LSAD-1
title: Life Safety Audio Defeat
description: Compact life safety audio defeat unit that automatically silences background audio when triggered by fire alarm systems.
detailDescription: The LSAD-1 kills background audio when triggered by a life safety or fire alarm system. It also provides an interface to non-fire paging equipment for non-emergency paging applications. Works with all common fire panels and alarm systems.

specifications.value: All common fire panels and alarms

features: Automatically silences background audio on fire alarm trigger
Works with all life safety systems
Easy to install with existing fire systems
applications: Life safety compliance for audio systems
